scope: Real Gemini speech; synthetic camera; private real program encode and decode

parts.text: Welcome to Breadcast! This is The New Agentic Economy Hackathon.
From Forever twenty-two at Betaworks, New York, supported by Google DeepMind.
Live voice, clever agents, and real demos. We are here to see what these builders can do!
I will call the action. My co-commentator will keep me honest. Let us see what is happening!
